The main takeaway from our work is that

US-triggered tumor-penetrant codelivery of anti-cancer drugs and siRNA targeting anti-apoptosis genes can be achieved using a nanobubble hetero-assembly system, leading to a synergistic anti-carcinogenic effect in HCC treatment.

the tumor-penetrant codelivery of anti-cancer drug PTX and siRNA targeting antiapoptotic gene BCL-2 was effectively achieved using the hetero-assembled nanobubbles (PTX-NB/siRNA), which was further proved to be a promising nanomedicine for effective chemotherapy of hepatocelluar carcinoma.
